HALF-A CLOSABILITY, RE-MEASURED AGAINST THE SHIPPED COMBINED STAGE. HALF A = the 16 of CH's 25 combined-stage carriers whose TU sorts below `game/n`, minus the TUs owned by other lanes this run. RESULT: 1 NEW EXACT, 1 ALREADY EXACT, 14 REFUSE WITH THE BAR NAMED AND RE-TESTED. Every verdict is webfrank.apply_patch's own residual count against the real object, not a simulation.

CLOSES -- game/audio/dcs::update_chinfo (75 insns), authored and shipped: permutation [0x68,0x78) order [0,2,1,3], combined site +0x84 `constant_dataflow_recolor` our_source r22, copy_register_fields. This is the function CH ruled refusing; see claim.law.HA_a-stage-simulation-that-copies-the-target-word-measures-a-design-the-project-did-not-build.20260901.v1.

ALREADY EXACT -- game/crt/vsprintf::vsprintf. Its existing rule closes it (fndiff real 0, fuzzy 100.0000%); the 16 words this analysis sees are in the RAW body the rule then absorbs. It is the only other HALF-A carrier whose unabsorbed span is a genuine reordering, so the roster's remaining payoff is zero and NOT merely underived.

THE 14 REFUSALS, EACH WITH THE BAR NAMED. The bar is per-cluster and a function refuses if ANY cluster is barred.
  STRUCTURAL (10) -- the span is not a reordering of the same work: the register-erased word multisets differ, i.e. differing immediates or differing opcodes. WebFrank must never touch these and they are SOURCE-reachable, which is where they should be worked. movieplayer::fn_800D96B0 (ours `addi r3,r31,24` against the target's `addi r3,r31,32` -- a field offset, one word, and the cheapest source lead in the set), movieplayer::fn_800D8BCC, dcs::dcsVoicePlay, critter::CritterRemoveColnodeSub, critter::CritterAnimate, critter::CritterDamage, auxanim::DoTexModSeqSub, gamemain::fn_8005351C, player::set_hidden_player, enemy::do_enemy_move, action::DoPlayerAction.
  LMW/STMW (3) -- register_slot_mask returns 0 for opcodes 46/47, so the words are not recolourable at all: mb_model::MBOX_BGLoadModelStart (+0x10), auxanim::InitOAnimList (+0xc), adstream::AdsPutBuffer (+0x10). CH named this bar for InitOAnimList and CritterDamage; it is confirmed and its membership extended.

THE ATTRIBUTIONS WERE RE-TESTED, WHICH CHANGED ONE OF THEM. Calling a cluster structural from the EXACT span of unabsorbed words is unsound on its own: a word displaced ACROSS the span boundary leaves the multisets unequal at that span and equal at a wider one. ha_widen re-ran every refusal over all windows up to 24 atoms with up to 16 atoms of slack per side, rejecting any window containing a control instruction or an lmw/stmw. Exactly one carrier changed verdict under the wider test -- vsprintf, which is already exact -- and every other carrier has at least one cluster with NO legal window at any width. Two further instrument faults were caught the same way and are recorded in claim.law.HA_relocations-ride-their-atom-into-the-proof-inputs-too-not-only-into-the-hashes.20260901.v1; both had produced refusals that read as properties of a function.

CONSEQUENCE FOR TRIAGE. HALF A is now CLOSED as a postprocessor opportunity: its combined-stage payoff was one function and it has been taken. The 13 non-vsprintf refusals should NOT be re-derived as postprocessor candidates by a later lane -- the bars are structural, per-cluster, and re-tested at width. They should be re-entered as SOURCE work, and fn_800D96B0's single wrong displacement (24 against 32 at +0x17c) is the concrete starting point. The general lesson matches CH's own and is strengthened rather than overturned: the combined stage is an enabler whose payoff is thin and concentrated, and the honest way to size it is to derive-and-prove every carrier rather than to rank them.
